title: Everything was very good!! lots of information and culture from our guide Luis
text: Everything was excellent! A very good tour and very rich in history
author: ximenalanzaro

title: Nerve wracking, but it worked well!
text:
We booked tickets the day before our visit to the Alhambra. 
After the initial confirmation of our ticket purchase, we were anxiously waiting for the tickets to arrive late the night before our visit, but they did arrive and we had no problem at all using them the next day. 
Good communication with Whatsapp and email. Thank you!
author: Christine_P

title: Amazing service! It may...
text: Amazing service! It may feel a little nerve-racking at first since the tickets are delivered at the last minute, but they do come through as promised. Trust them and you’ll be totally fine. Highly recommended!
author: Yuting_S

title: Hope is the last to die
text: I had lost hope of seeing the Alhambra, because the tickets were sold out.But thanks to Viator I found them.They were expensive, but I could make the visit to the Arab citadel + train visit of Granada.You can not leave Granada without seeing the Alhambra.
author: Maria_C

title: Excellent last minute tickets
text: Well worth it . I did not realise I needed to buy tickets in advance. As whole point of hol was willing to pay for the last minute tickets but worried it might be a scam. It wasn't . Delivered exactly what they advertised excellent communication particularly by what's app. Would recommend trustworthy for last minute tickets and alhambra is glorious . Worth the premium price as gets last minute entry to Alhambra after the Alhambra website has sold off l
author: Alyson_W

title: Good opportunity last minute tickets
text: We received the tickets around 11 PM the day before. We knew there was no guarantee for the tickets and were flexible regarding the entry time. Everything went smoothly. Not suitable for people who need a specific time slot or certainty in their planning. And the price for the service is costly.
author: Christoph W

title: Everything went well. If...
text: Everything went well. If you really want to go to Alhambra without buying tickets months before, you can get here. However, time slot is simply what is available, so you can't plan
author: Fransiskus_W

title: Viste Nasrid Palaces Granada
text: Great experience. Last minute service at the top.
author: Cosmopolitan742422

title: Good option for the last minute tickets for Alhambra
text: Very good option for the last minute tickets , i booked 2 tickets one day before my visit to Alhambra , they sent me the tickets in the evening , Alhambra is amazing place , absolutely it's better to buy the tickets early but if you are in the same situation as me this is q good option as a last minute so it's normal that it's expensive but as we received the tickets and everything worked well in the entrances it's fine
author: Ibrahim_E

title: Reliable
text: Yes, it is more expensive than the official tickets. But a reliable way to visit the alhambra anyway. Service was good. There were explanations on top. We're satisfied.
